what: per-basin calibration of each model on the CAMELS-US DEV basins (B splits), NSE objective, JADE differential evolution 40 x 80 (3,240 runs), forcing Caravan ERA5-Land, PET = Caravan FAO-56 PM

periods.note: the CAMELS validation years 1989-10..1999-09 are B's temporal EXAM period and were not used; both validation windows here are non-exam

prior_skill: skill of the uncalibrated attribute-prior parameters: see prior_skill.json (the per-record "prior_cal" entries in out/dev_calib* used transfer-function versions in development and are not reported)
literature_context: Newman et al. (2017) SAC-SMA+Snow-17 CAMELS benchmark median NSE ~0.6-0.65 (validation); Kratzert et al. (2019) LSTM median NSE ~0.74-0.76 (validation 1989-1999, Daymet/Maurer/NLDAS forcing)
